shipRule: segments.json is written only when at least 90% of the 2025 street cleaning tickets placed on a block side land on a side the schedule sweeps that day, 8 to 12 (a side left off the map counts as a miss)

schedule.what: One date list per street cleaning district and side (odd or even house numbers), April to December 2026, as the City lists them; every block side with that district and parity gets the list
otherMovedDates: B-even (1st Tue): 2026-09-01 → 2026-09-08, holiday_adjustments "", 2026-09-01 is no City holiday
schedule.hours: 8 to 12 everywhere: the City publishes no hours and says most streets are 8 AM to noon and a few differ; the posted sign decides
schedule.dataCovers: 2026 only: the City posts each year's dates; after the last 2026 date the map has no next sweep until the 2027 schedule is built

placement.sideRule: A block side takes the street cleaning district of at least 75% of its addresses (addresses with no district count against it); otherwise it is left off the map

ticketHours.what: Every 2025 street cleaning ticket by the hour it was written (local time)

ticketCheck.what: 2025 street cleaning tickets (violation S1) against the schedule: is the ticket on a street, a street side (its house number's parity) and a block side the schedule sweeps on that weekday of that week, 8 AM to noon? The 2026 lists are read by their day on the signs ("1st Wed") on 2025's calendar; 5th weekdays, where only make-up days fall, are left out.
ticketCheck.notes: corner = written at an intersection, side unknown; makeUpDay = written on a 5th weekday of a month (days 29 to 31); notPlaced = the house number is in no centerline address range, within 20 (counted at street level only); streetNotSwept = no side of that street is on the map; blockLevel: dayNotHour = swept that day, the ticket outside 8 to 12; otherSide = the other side of the block is swept then; otherDay = the side is swept on another day; sideLeftOut = the side is not on the map (see placement.leftOut)
